metaTitle: Airtable to Webflow Integration Guide | B2B Sync
metaDescription: Learn how to seamlessly sync Airtable records to Webflow CMS collections with automated triggers, zero code, and Make middleware.
topUseCases: Auto-publish programmatic SEO landing pages from curated Airtable tables.
Sync multi-author blog drafts and asset attachments into Webflow CMS items.
Update product inventory and pricing on live marketing pages without designer intervention.
stepByStepGuide: Generate an Airtable Personal Access Token (PAT) with data.records:read scopes.
Create an API Token in Webflow Site Settings under the Integrations tab.
In Make (formerly Integromat), create a scenario starting with the 'Airtable - Watch Records' trigger module.
Add the 'Webflow - Create/Update Item' action module and map table fields to CMS collection schema.
Enable instant Webhook triggers in Airtable and turn on the Make scenario schedule.
commonPitfalls: Hitting Webflow's rate limit of 60 requests/minute during bulk imports from Airtable without a pacing delay.
Field type mismatches (e.g. multi-reference IDs vs plain text slugs) causing silent CMS item creation failures.

metaTitle: HubSpot to Slack Integration Guide (Native Sync)
metaDescription: Connect HubSpot to Slack to receive real-time deal alerts, lead notifications, and trigger slash commands directly inside Slack channels.
topUseCases: Post real-time notifications to #sales-wins when high-value deals enter 'Closed Won'.
Assign inbound leads immediately by alerting reps in designated rep channels.
Search CRM contacts and log meeting notes directly from Slack using /hubspot commands.
stepByStepGuide: Navigate to HubSpot App Marketplace and search for the official Slack integration.
Click 'Install app' and authorize permissions for your target Slack workspace.
Under HubSpot Settings > Integrations > Connected Apps, configure default channel notifications.
Create a HubSpot Workflow to trigger conditional Slack channel messages based on Deal Stage updates.
commonPitfalls: Over-notifying general channels with low-priority lead changes, creating notification fatigue.
Failing to map individual HubSpot user accounts to Slack users, preventing direct @mentions in alerts.

metaTitle: Stripe to QuickBooks Online Integration Guide
metaDescription: Automate invoice reconciliation, subscription payments, and customer records between Stripe and QuickBooks Online via Zapier.
topUseCases: Auto-generate Sales Receipts in QuickBooks whenever a successful Stripe charge occurs.
Deduct Stripe processing fees automatically into a designated COGS expense account.
Sync customer billing addresses and tax identification numbers for global compliance.
stepByStepGuide: Connect your Stripe account with restricted API read keys for charge and customer events.
Authenticate QuickBooks Online in Zapier using company admin credentials.
Create a Zap triggered by 'New Successful Charge in Stripe'.
Add a 'Find or Create Customer in QuickBooks Online' search step to avoid duplicate contacts.
Configure 'Create Sales Receipt' action with split lines for gross revenue and Stripe merchant processing fees.
commonPitfalls: Omitting Stripe fee line items, leading to discrepancies between bank deposits and book revenue totals.
Failing to account for refund events, resulting in overstated gross revenue numbers in QuickBooks.

metaDescription: Sync Salesforce accounts, opportunities, and key pipeline metrics into Notion databases for team-wide cross-functional visibility.
topUseCases: Maintain a real-time account directory in Notion for non-Salesforce licensed product and CS teams.
Embed live quarterly pipeline rollups inside company all-hands workspace documents.
Trigger kickoff project workspaces in Notion when an Enterprise deal closes in Salesforce.
stepByStepGuide: Create a Connected App in Salesforce with OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials.
Build an internal integration token in Notion and share target database pages with the integration.
Set up a Make webhook listener receiving Salesforce Outbound Messages or CDC (Change Data Capture) events.
Map Salesforce Opportunity fields (Amount, Stage, Close Date, Owner) to Notion database properties.
Add error handling paths for custom field validation and rate-limit retries.
commonPitfalls: Syncing too many granular SFDC fields into Notion, hitting database block limits and slowing Notion search.
Not accounting for Salesforce sandboxes vs production instance URLs during OAuth configuration.

metaDescription: Streamline engineering notifications by syncing Linear issue updates, PR links, and project roadmaps directly to your team Slack channels.
topUseCases: Broadcast urgent P0/Triage issues into engineering on-call channels immediately.
Allow team members to create Linear issues directly from Slack messages with one click.
Sync personal issue assignees with Slack personal DMs for review reminders.
stepByStepGuide: Open Linear Settings and navigate to 'Integrations' > 'Slack'.
Click 'Connect to Slack' and authorize the Linear bot in your workspace.
Configure project-level and team-level channel notification rules.
Enable the Slack shortcut 'Create Linear Issue' for seamless task filing from chat threads.
commonPitfalls: Subscribing high-activity team backlogs to high-traffic channels without filtering by priority or label.
Forgetting to link individual Linear accounts to Slack users for personalized direct notification routing.

metaTitle: Shopify to Klaviyo Sync & Setup Guide
metaDescription: Integrate Shopify with Klaviyo to automate abandoned cart emails, customer segment tracking, and purchase revenue analytics in real-time.
topUseCases: Trigger personalized abandoned checkout and abandoned browse email sequences.
Segment VIP customers dynamically based on historical Lifetime Value (LTV) and order frequencies.
Sync onsite SMS opt-in phone numbers with checkout compliance timestamps.
stepByStepGuide: Install the official Klaviyo app from the Shopify App Store.
Check 'Automatically add Klaviyo onsite JavaScript' and select sync historical data options.
Configure SMS marketing compliance disclosures in Shopify Checkout settings.
Verify tracking by triggering a test 'Started Checkout' event in an incognito browser window.
commonPitfalls: Neglecting GDPR/TCPA compliance checkboxes, resulting in un-subscribed contacts receiving promotional SMS.
Not waiting for historical order data sync to complete before launching automated segment-based flows.

metaTitle: Zendesk to Jira Service Management Sync
metaDescription: Connect Zendesk customer tickets to Jira development issues to streamline cross-team bug resolution and status updates automatically.
topUseCases: Escalate customer bug reports from Zendesk tickets into Jira engineering backlog issues.
Sync Jira issue status transitions back to Zendesk tickets as internal agent notes.
Allow support agents to track engineering progress without requiring full Jira seat licenses.
stepByStepGuide: Install the Zendesk Support app for Jira from Atlassian Marketplace.
Install the Jira Cloud app in the Zendesk Support Admin Center.
Authorize bi-directional permissions between your Atlassian and Zendesk instances.
Map Jira issue types (Bug, Task, Story) and priority levels to Zendesk ticket types.
Enable automated two-way comment synchronization and status change notifications.
commonPitfalls: Accidentally syncing private engineering Jira comments back to end-users as public Zendesk replies.
Missing custom field definitions in Jira, causing issue creation errors when triggered from Zendesk.

metaDescription: Sync Intercom conversational leads, conversation transcripts, and visitor data directly to Salesforce CRM leads and contacts natively.
topUseCases: Automatically create or update Salesforce Leads when qualification bots capture visitor contact info.
Log completed Intercom conversation transcripts as Salesforce Task activities on Contact records.
Route VIP Salesforce Accounts directly to dedicated account reps when they initiate live chat.
stepByStepGuide: In Intercom App Store, select the Salesforce app and authenticate with a Salesforce System Administrator user.
Map Intercom visitor data fields (Email, Company, Industry) to standard and custom Salesforce Lead fields.
Define duplicate management rules to update existing records rather than creating duplicate Leads.
Enable real-time activity logging for chat transcripts, qualification events, and meeting bookings.
commonPitfalls: Failing to respect Salesforce required validation rules on Lead creation, causing silent sync rejections.
Assigning the integration user insufficient Field-Level Security (FLS) permissions in Salesforce.

metaTitle: GitHub to Linear Integration & PR Sync
metaDescription: Connect GitHub pull requests, commits, and branch workflows directly to Linear issues for automated sprint tracking and issue resolution.
topUseCases: Automatically move Linear issues to 'In Progress' when a git branch with the issue identifier is pushed.
Attach GitHub Pull Request status, review approvals, and CI check status directly on Linear cards.
Close Linear issues automatically when corresponding pull requests are merged into the default branch.
stepByStepGuide: Open Linear Settings > Integrations > GitHub.
Click 'Install GitHub App' and select the specific repositories or entire GitHub organization to connect.
Configure automation rules for branch creation, draft pull requests, and PR merge behaviors.
Copy branch names from Linear issues with git branch prefixes for seamless linking.
commonPitfalls: Omitting the Linear issue key (e.g. ENG-123) in branch names or PR titles, breaking the automatic association.
Connecting an entire enterprise GitHub org without repository filtering, syncing unintended internal repos.

metaTitle: PostgreSQL to Google Sheets Data Pipeline
metaDescription: Automate scheduled exports and query syncs from PostgreSQL databases into Google Sheets for executive reporting without SQL scripts.
topUseCases: Push daily transactional metrics and MRR summaries to leadership spreadsheets automatically.
Sync customer cohort segments into Google Sheets for marketing team ad-hoc analysis.
Trigger alert rows whenever abnormal error counts or spikes are detected in production tables.
stepByStepGuide: Create a read-only database user in PostgreSQL with SELECT-only grants on target tables or views.
Whitelist Zapier / middleware IP addresses in your database firewall or cloud security group.
Set up a Zapier trigger using 'New or Updated Row in PostgreSQL' or a scheduled query interval.
Select the target Google Spreadsheet and Sheet tab.
Map returned SQL columns to corresponding Google Sheet column headers with append or upsert logic.
commonPitfalls: Granting write or administrative permissions to the integration user instead of strict read-only access.
Querying unindexed, massive tables on short polling schedules, creating high CPU load on the production database.
